title: Unbound method exports
description: Design pattern for exporting client methods as unbound functions.
body: `index.ts` exports every client method unbound (`export const invoke = client.invoke`), so anything reaching for `this` would break for every caller of the shorthand. This is deliberate: the methods are named rather than written straight into a literal so that `declareCommands` and `subscribe` (which call other methods) can refer to them by name without losing `this`.
